application_order: checkout the recorded CVA6 revision and initialize the HPDcache submodule at the recorded revision
run harness/evaluate.sh with the submitted candidate; it checks the ports, then the shared evaluator replaces the module in the fixed CPU and checks architectural traces

reconstruction.reference_hdl: read rtl/src/common/hpdcache_rrarb.sv from HPDcache submodule f404e7ebbda8baa4af3729535f520a6b12a06d03, which CVA6 revision 6348e9e684678f83b40d0520028513d06b36e7b2 records
reconstruction.test_sources: git checkout the recorded architectural-test revision; use the unmodified CVA6 test list.

port_test.scope: N=4 and N=8, the cv32a60x instances, binary inputs: single and zero requests, grant retention while the selected request remains asserted, two full rotations for every nonempty stable request subset, and one-hot selection and hold under dynamic competition. 2962 observations must complete before CPU evaluation.
port_test.requirements: SPEC ports and arbitration requirements: exclusive grant, order for fixed request sets, reset, and grant hold.
port_test.failure_classes: PASS 0: complete zero-error observations. The fixed bench builds and runs with the reference module, so a build failure, an abnormal end, a missing or incomplete observation record and an explicit mismatch are FAIL (1). Missing fixed tools or inputs, resource exhaustion and wall-clock timeouts are INVALID (2).
